decision: A pve-container build newer than the compatible-versions list is not untested on that ground alone: the overlay matches the checksum of the guarded files, each guard on its own, so judge a node from its journal line, never by version.

evidence.text: lib/PVE/LXC/BindSnap.pm keys the known-good table on the combined sha256 of @GUARDED_FILES. RED (opus) on the pre-edit text could not tell checksum from version; GREEN (opus, haiku) answered from the new text.

reopen_if: The overlay starts keying vetted builds on the package version.
why: Readers compared the node's version with the top of the list and concluded TEST mode, while an unchanged guarded file set validates as checksum-validated with no new row.
